next.reason: The ban is the same for report files. 2023 §2023:14.9.27.4 GR6 adds exceptions ('except for a MERGE or SORT statement with the USING or GIVING phrase, the COMMIT and ROLLBACK statements, a DELETE FILE statement, or an OPEN statement'), but SORT, MERGE and DELETE FILE cannot name a report file (§2023:13.18.46.3 SR3; 1985 XIII.3.3.3 SR3 likewise) and COMMIT/ROLLBACK are not 1985 statements, so the store's reason does not change a 1985 program; §2023:14.9.27.4 GR8 restates the open-mode requirement. What changed: 1985 leaves undefined an INITIATE that implicitly references a report file not in an open mode; 2023 §2023:14.9.21.4 GR3 sets EC-REPORT-FILE-MODE and takes no action on the report.
